_comment: F02 Tunnels: callers of the contact allocator during the any% run. Regenerate: tools/phase4_f02_spawner_trace.py
why_not_ram_diffing: The contact pool is round-robin recycled by the cursor at 0x8008234C, so a slot is not an object: sampling the pool showed all 64 slots churning with balanced up/down motion. The allocator's callers identify spawners; slot diffs cannot.
verdict: CAPTURED -- 7280 allocator calls from 37 distinct callers during the Tunnels run. Each caller is a spawner candidate for the row's 'bind them to their spawner' item.
